section.title: Notification Delivery: Sync or Queued
section.scenario: Order confirmation emails currently send synchronously inside the checkout request. Checkout p95 latency is 900ms, and the mail provider occasionally takes 3-4s under load.
section.question: Would you move notification delivery to a background queue, and how would you justify that choice?
options: Keep sending synchronously inside the request
Move delivery to a background job queue
Batch and send notifications on a short delay
section.teaching_note: Weigh checkout latency against what happens if a queued job silently fails.
